name: Jari Matti Virtanen
bio:
Jari Matti's journey into motorsport was unexpected, beginning with a small catering company in Helsinki that landed a contract with a local rally team. His dedication to providing high-quality, nutritious meals quickly gained him a reputation within the Finnish rally scene. This eventually led to opportunities within Formula racing.

At Hendrick Motorsports, Jari Matti oversees all aspects of team catering, from sourcing ingredients to managing the kitchen staff at races and events. He is known for his meticulous planning and ability to adapt to the logistical challenges of a travelling race team. Jari Matti believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and his commitment to providing top-notch culinary support is unwavering.

What sets Jari Matti apart is his 'sisu,' a Finnish term for resilience and determination. He can handle the pressure of race weekends with grace and always finds a way to deliver, no matter the circumstances. He is also a mentor to younger members of the catering staff, sharing his knowledge and passion for food.

physical.description: Jari Matti is a stocky man, built strong from years of hard work, with a perpetually kind expression.

quirks: Insists on using only Finnish coffee beans, even when overseas.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and catering ideas.
Starts every day with a traditional Finnish sauna, regardless of location.
